decisions.reason: As the firm's flagship GIS platform and a direct expression of its strategy in integrated enterprise geospatial solutions, it strongly builds on existing knowledge, standards work, and partner links, so management would likely keep developing it.

Mobile field data capture is closely related to the firm's geospatial integration and public-sector workflow capabilities, giving it enough absorptive capacity to improve and commercialize it, though it could later be folded into broader solution offerings.

Although the search extension fits the firm's web-mapping expertise, it is a narrower add-on in a firm that has already culled similar plugins, so management is likely to reallocate resources toward the core platform and larger integrated solutions.
